question: Calculate the percentage of molecules containing carcinogenic compounds that element is hydrogen.
evidence: hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+' and element = 'h'), COUNT(molecule_id)) * 100.0
clarification: Count each distinct molecule_id only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' AND T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
gold0: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' AND T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

d.request: Calculate the percentage of molecules that contain carcinogenic compounds (label = '+') in which the element is hydrogen (element = 'h'), counting each distinct molecule_id only once, using the formula: percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+' and element = 'h'), COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id)) * 100.0.
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' THEN m.molecule_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage FROM molecule m INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

c.request:
Calculate the percentage of molecules containing carcinogenic compounds that element is hydrogen.
Evidence: hydrogen refers to element = 'h'; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+' and element = 'h'), COUNT(molecule_id)) * 100.0
Count each distinct molecule_id only once.
c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' AND m.label = '+' THEN m.molecule_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

b.request: Calculate the percentage of distinct molecules (each molecule_id counted once) that are carcinogenic (label = '+') and contain at least one hydrogen atom (element = 'h'), out of all distinct molecules
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'h') THEN m.molecule_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage FROM molecule m
